source_limitations: Coin Metrics MVRV is a current historical vintage; original daily publication times and historical as-of versions are unverified.
D+1 visibility is an unverified proxy; Binance ZIPs may have been revised.
Historical order-book impact, margin tiers and live fills are not fully observed.
Coin Metrics and Binance Vision sources are for non-commercial research under their terms; live/commercial use requires separate rights.

coin_metrics.modifications: Daily MVRV was mapped to weekly 365-day median-relative directions.

binance_vision.modifications: Official bars and funding were transformed into derived backtest metrics.
